description: An RRH1 frame (the sender seed's P2P_ID, then five INET_DIRECT entries, type 0x24): a port with a leading zero (not canonical), port 0, two good ones (the second with every flag bit set) and a third good one past the limit of 2. Each bad or extra entry is dropped alone with an RRH1_MALFORMED debug log; the frame, its P2P_ID and the two good entries (unknown flag bits cleared) are kept
name: INET_DIRECT entries that break §13.3
